title: Unique Roasted Slovakian Lemongrass Casserole
description: A roasted, velvety, nostalgic Slovakian dish featuring lemongrass, this casserole is perfect for a special occasion, it is ovo-vegetarian-friendly and has a unique smoky flavor.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they are tender.
Add the cubed tofu and cook until it is lightly browned.
Add the lemongrass, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Pour in the vegetable broth and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and roast in the preheated oven for 30 minutes.
